chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him): When it reached him the accusation of the Banu Umayya against him for participation in the blood of Uthman

key_terms.بَنِي أُمَيَّةَ: The Umayyad clan, a prominent Qurayshi family that later established the Caliphate
key_terms.عُثْمَانَ: Uthman ibn Affan, the third Rashidun Caliph

ai.seo_question: What was the Umayyad accusation against Ali regarding the death of Uuthman?
ai.summary: This passage from Nahj al-Balagha captures Ali ibn Abi Talib’s strategic response to the Umayyads' political maneuvering, specifically Muawiya’s use of the 'blood of Uthman' slogan to legitimize his claim to power. It highlights the Shia scholarly view that Ali’s delay in punishing the killers was a calculated move to avoid civil war, contrasting with the Umayyad narrative of immediate retribution. This context underscores the transition from the Rashidun era to the Umayyad caliphate, framing the conflict as one of political legitimacy rather than mere succession.
